notes.title: Telecom Discipline – VE Checklist
notes.body:
## Scope
Telecom discipline value engineering checklist covering fiber optic networks, CCTV systems, telecom rooms, redundancy philosophy, cable routing, cable trays, and underground ducting.

Content extracted verbatim from VE checklist items.

notes.title: Fiber Optic Network Optimization
notes.body:
## VE Items
- Review and optimize fiber optic (FO) network architecture including FO cable allocation per system, reuse of existing FO infrastructure, optimization of FO patch panels and network cabinets.
- Apply multi-core fiber optic cable sharing among multiple telecom systems. (20-EN-EL-069)
- Adopt single FO cable combined with wireless link instead of dual redundant FO cables where acceptable. (16-EN-CI-009)
- Review long-distance FO routing and reroute links through nearest existing substation or building. (17-EN-CI-014)

notes.title: CCTV System Optimization
notes.body:
## VE Items
- Change CCTV feeder connection scheme from centralized to local connection using local rack rooms or field distribution panels. (26-EN-EL-001)
- Evaluate economical cabling method for IP CCTV between camera and junction box. (25-EN-EL-009)
- Reduce CCTV camera quantity by eliminating overlapping coverage. (19-EN-EL-020)
- Exclude cryogenic CCTV cameras in tanks after cost and maintainability review.

notes.title: Telecom Rooms and Cabinets Layout
notes.body:
## VE Items
- Optimize telecom rack room and communication cabinet locations.
- Align telecom rooms vertically in multi-story buildings.
- Reuse existing LAN and telephone system equipment in existing control buildings. (19-EN-EL-021)

notes.title: Telecom Redundancy Philosophy
notes.body:
## VE Items
- Apply full telecom system redundancy only to major manned buildings. (20-EN-EL-032)
- Review feasibility of integrating PA, Paging, and Siren systems.
- Optimize paging station quantity on elevated platforms.

notes.title: Cable Routing and Cable Tray Optimization
notes.body:
## VE Items
- Optimize telecom cable routing during FEED or early design.
- Review cable tray segregation per IEC standards. (23-EN-CI-025)
- Increase tray support span where structurally allowable. (20-EN-CI-011)
- Optimize tray thickness based on loading and span. (22-EN-CI-004)
- Omit tray fireproofing where fire-resistant cables are applied. (19-EN-CI-041)

notes.title: Underground Fiber Optic Ducting
notes.body:
## VE Items
- Replace underground FO duct bank construction with Corrugated Optical Duct (COD) systems where permitted.

notes.title: Shared Fiber Optic Infrastructure
notes.body:
## Shared Infrastructure
- Existing fiber optic cables
- Multi-core fiber optic cables
- FO patch panels
- Network cabinets

notes.title: Shared Cable Tray Infrastructure
notes.body:
## Shared Infrastructure
- Cable trays
- Tray supports
- Tray fireproofing philosophy
- Segregation rules per IEC

notes.title: Existing Building Infrastructure
notes.body:
## Shared Infrastructure
- Existing control buildings
- Existing LAN systems
- Existing telephone systems
